articles.title: OpenAI Weighs IPO in 2027 After Expected Anthropic Public Debut
articles.summary: OpenAI is considering an initial public offering as soon as in 2027, according to people familiar with the matter, a timeline that would potentially see it go public after its artificial intelligence rival Anthropic PBC.

articles.title: Apple’s Vision Pro and Smart Glasses Chief to Join OpenAI
articles.summary: Apple Inc.’s top executive in charge of the Vision Pro headset and the company’s smart glasses efforts is leaving for OpenAI, continuing a streak of high-profile defections to rivals in the artificial intelligence and hardware sectors.

articles.title: Anthropic Moves Toward Deal With US to Lift Curbs on AI Models
articles.summary: Anthropic PBC and the Trump administration are moving closer to an agreement that would lift US restrictions on the company’s top two artificial intelligence models after weeks of talks between the two sides over security of the systems, according to people familiar with the matter.
